cases.prompt: Create a Surface application specification for an FAQ page at /faq with three ordered questions and answers. Make one answer contain two blocks of text separated by a blank line.
acceptance: The result is valid Surface 0.1 KDL.
The result contains exactly one application and at least one screen.
The application has no version property.
The screen route is /faq and contains three sections in the requested order.
Each section name is a question and its text is the answer.
The two-block answer uses one valid multiline text node.
The result does not use question or answer nodes.
The result does not introduce syntax from a later rung.

cases.prompt: Add a question and multiline answer to the end of a valid Static FAQ screen that contains two section-based entries, a comment, and a context node.
acceptance: The result adds exactly one section after the existing sections.
The new section name is the question and its multiline text is the answer.
The multiline text remains semantically unchanged after formatting.
The existing comment, context node, and unrelated content are preserved.
The result remains valid Surface 0.1 KDL.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a Static FAQ file containing an empty section, a numeric text node, an unsupported question node, and a section with two titles.
acceptance: The response identifies all four validation problems.
The response distinguishes valid KDL from valid Surface.
Every suggested correction uses only released rung-1 and rung-2 syntax.
